# Quantum Time Sync — entropy extraction over the time-delta stream
#
# EXPERIMENTAL ENTROPY SOURCE — NOT CERTIFIED FOR CRYPTOGRAPHIC USE.
# Do not use this output as cryptographic key material.
#
# PROVENANCE: downstream of Will Bickford — his fleet, his Quantum
# Time Sync protocol (task 26.6.11/8.7.14/8.6.10), published as an
# entropy source under task 25.7.10/9.8.14/7.6.9. The full atom
# stream this is extracted from is feed.txt, published alongside.
#
# SOURCE MECHANISM (Will, 2026-11-22): the entropy is generated by
# the fleet's work itself. Dispatched workloads drive CPU clock
# frequency management — DVFS governor transitions as load rises
# and falls — and those transitions stir each node's timing
# jitter. No dispatched work, a quieter stream; the work is the
# driver of the entropy, and the deltas carry its imprint.
#
# METHOD: one block per census round.
# block = SHA-256(canonical round text), where the canonical text
# is exactly the round's 'delta ...' lines as printed in feed.txt,
# in register order, UTF-8, LF-terminated. Recompute from feed.txt
# alone to verify. Superseded rounds are withheld (see feed.txt).
#
# MEASURED MIN-ENTROPY OF THE RAW STREAM (most-common-value
# estimator, H_min = -log2(p_max), over the pooled rounds on
# record, values at recorded precision 0.001; low-digit column:
# the same estimator over the low-order digit alone):
#   offset_ms  n=57   H_min=4.833 bits/value (most common value x2)  low-digit H_min=2.663 bits
#   jitter_ms  n=55   H_min=4.781 bits/value (most common value x2)  low-digit H_min=2.196 bits
#   ppm        n=50   H_min=4.644 bits/value (most common value x2)  low-digit H_min=2.644 bits
# Read these as young-stream measurements, not guarantees: the
# pool is 3 rounds, and nodes share network-time sources, so
# cross-node values are correlated — per-round totals got by
# adding per-value figures would overstate the entropy and are
# not claimed. The conditioned blocks below are 32 bytes per
# round regardless; conditioning does not create entropy, it
# concentrates what the raw stream carries.
#
# HEALTH CHECKS ON THE CONDITIONED OUTPUT SO FAR
# (descriptive only — at 96 bytes no significance attaches):
#   bytes=96 bits=768 ones=389 ones_fraction=0.507
#   distinct_byte_values=77 max_byte_count=3 chi2_vs_uniform=282.7 (df=255)
#
# WHAT LIFTING THE LABEL WOULD REQUIRE: a long stream (months of
# daily rounds, not three rounds in one morning); SP 800-90B-style
# health testing on the raw noise source (repetition-count and
# adaptive-proportion tests running continuously, restart tests);
# and an entropy assessment over that long stream by someone other
# than the publisher. Until then the label above stands.
